# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows the caster to gauge what the tastes of the target are (e.g., is he a
collector of rare books, old maps or vintage wines, etc.).
@@ 2
The caster causes one target to perceive the item as the caster wishes. Any
and all senses may be changed as the illusion is all in the target’s mind.
However the nature of the item may not be changed (e.g., a book will remain a
book, a map will still be a map).
@@ 3
Causes the caster to be more convincing than normal, providing a +25 bonus to
the caster’s next attempt to influence someone verbally. This bonus lasts for
the whole of the next attempt and may be applied to any appropriate maneuver
(at the GM’s discretion; e.g., Duping, Seduction etc.).
@@ 4
As Item Charade I, except allows the caster to completely change how he is
physically perceived by one target.
@@ 5
Caster’s skin becomes sensitive to magic. Whenever a spell is cast on him
during the duration of this spell, his skin will tingle. He will gain no
information about the spell at all, only that he was the target of magic..
This will detect even Passive or Informational spells.
@@ 6
As Item Charade I, except the target will perceive any one animal as any
animal of the same type (e.g., a cat will still look like a cat, but it can be
any type of cat of the same basic size).
@@ 7
Causes the next lie the caster tells to be free of the normal signs used to
detect lies. This results in a special modification of -25 to any non-magical
attempts at lie detection and a special bonus of +25 to any RRs versus magical
attempts at lie detection.
@@ 8
Allows the caster to alter one of the following to magical/mental detections:
his race, profession, or level.
@@ 9
As Minor Magic Sense, except the caster’s skin is sensitive enough to detect
magic in or on objects which he touches.
@@ 10
As Item Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.
@@ 11
As Loquaciousness I, except the bonus is +50.
@@ 12
As Personal Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.
@@ 13
As Creature Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.
@@ 14
As Lesser Magic Sense, except the caster learns the realm of magic and the
direction from whence the spell came (if appropriate).
@@ 15
As Mental Charade I, except the caster can alter two of the following to
magical/mental detections: his level, race, or profession. Alternatively, the
caster can choose only one of the items and double the duration of this spell.
@@ 16
As Item Charade I, except the caster can affect 3 targets.
@@ 17
As Loquaciousness I, except the bonus is +75.
@@ 18
As Personal Charade I, but the caster can affect 3 targets.
@@ 19
As Creature Charade I, except the caster can affect 3 targets.
@@ 20
As Greater Magic Sense, except the caster can choose an area in which to
detect. He will detect any spells cast on the area after this spell is cast
and any magic items that enter the area (but will not discover any magics
which encompass an area larger than this spell).
@@ 25
As Mental Charade I, except the caster can alter his race, profession, and
level to magical and mental detections. Alternatively, the caster can choose
two of the above and double the normal duration; or the caster can choose only
one of the above and triple the normal duration.
@@ 30
As Item Charade I, except the caster can manipulate the perceptions of a
number of targets up to a maximum of caster’s level divided by 5.
@@ 50
As Personal Charade I, except the caster can manipulate the perceptions of a
number of targets up to a maximum of caster’a level divided by 5.
